name: membrane
description: Static-analysis security audit for Claude Code project configurations and enabled plugins. 21 rules across 6 aspects (secrets, permissions, hooks, MCP, CLAUDE.md, prompt-injection), over a closed input: printable-ASCII names, regular files, 1 MiB or less; anything else is one stop that names it. The report lists every hook command it read. Durable finding_uid survives whitespace edits (T2-I). Zero ambient surface (T1-C — SessionStart reminder is opt-in). Inspired by AgentShield in Everything Claude Code (Mustafa, 2026; MIT).
